description: YourProduct's client sales playbook — drafts client-facing messages in the premium-exclusivity brand voice, runs rebuttal sparring on objections, generates follow-up/check-in notes, and debriefs deals into lessons. Use this whenever the user is writing or planning ANY message to a YourProduct client or prospect (texts, emails, DMs, follow-ups, payment asks), handling an objection or stall ("she said it's too expensive", "he ghosted me", "they need more time"), deciding what to send after a missed deadline, or reviewing how a deal went — even if they don't say "closer" or "sales". Also use it when a client conversation needs a price, deposit, or payment-plan answer.
